articles.abstract_cn: 新材料、制造工艺和低温系统架构的适航认证在概念提出后可能需要5-9年，这意味着认证证据的产生，而非材料性能，可能成为将创新转化为飞机的速率限制步骤。液态氢（LH2）因其高比能量（约120 MJ kg−1）而对中远程航空具有吸引力，然而氢飞机不能仅通过燃料替代来实现。本综述考察了航空低温氢储存与燃料系统集成，主张LH2储罐应被视为嵌入飞机内的主动低温供应系统。它综合了热力学、流体、材料、结构、安全性和认证方面的挑战，借鉴了航空航天、海事和工业低温系统。一个核心发现是，理想的设计方向往往是相互对抗的。仅1 W的热泄漏对应于约2.24 mg s−1的氢蒸发损失，然而通过更先进的隔热减少热量进入可能会增加质量和系统复杂性。同样，过多的气相空间改善了压力控制裕度，但减少了可用液体体积，而晃动控制可能引入热桥。本综述将航空LH2设计重新定义为一个耦合问题，需要飞机尺度瞬态验证、全场诊断、标准化测试以及能够捕捉可靠性、检查和相互作用失效模式的框架。

articles.title_en: “Adoption pathways for green hydrogen in developing economies: A review- driven hybrid modelling framework with policy insights from India”
articles.title_cn: “发展中经济体绿色氢的采用途径：审查驱动的混合建模框架与印度的政策见解”
articles.abstract_en: Green Hydrogen (GH) is increasingly recognised as a cornerstone of the future energy economy, essential for sustainable transitions and long-term decarbonisation. It directly supports SDG-7 (Affordable and Clean Energy), SDG-9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure), and SDG-13 (Climate Action). Yet adoption pathways remain fragmented, with policy frameworks often emphasising production expansion while underplaying infrastructure, regulation, and institutional coherence. This study addresses the gap by combining a systematic review of global and national literature with expert consultations and policy document analysis to identify key determinants of GH adoption. A hybrid methodological framework—integrating Graph Theoretic Analysis(GTA), Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP), and Structural Equation Modelling(SEM)—is applied to prioritise determinants, quantify interdependencies, and validate causal linkages. Findings reveal that storage, transport infrastructure along with other enabling factors (finance, regulation, governance) exert greater influence on adoption rather than production and usage. This imbalance highlights the risks of production-centric policies, including those embedded in India's National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM). While India provides the empirical foundation, the framework offers generalizable insights for other developing and emerging economies, where modular infrastructure, blended finance, phased regulatory pathways, and institutional capacity-building are essential to overcome fragmented systems and accelerate GH adoption. By advancing a validated hybrid model, this study contributes both to policy review and to decision-support analytics, offering globally relevant guidance for accelerating hydrogen transitions.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色氢（GH）越来越被认为是未来能源经济的基石，对于可持续转型和长期脱碳至关重要。它直接支持 SDG-7（经济适用的清洁能源）、SDG-9（工业、创新和基础设施）和 SDG-13（气候行动）。然而，采用途径仍然支离破碎，政策框架往往强调生产扩张，而忽视基础设施、监管和机构一致性。本研究通过将全球和国家文献的系统回顾与专家咨询和政策文件分析相结合来解决这一差距，以确定 GH 采用的关键决定因素。应用集成图论分析 (GTA)、层次分析法 (AHP) 和结构方程模型 (SEM) 的混合方法框架来确定决定因素的优先级、量化相互依赖性并验证因果关系。调查结果表明，存储、运输基础设施以及其他促成因素（金融、监管、治理）对采用的影响比对生产和使用的影响更大。这种不平衡凸显了以生产为中心的政策的风险，包括印度国家绿色氢使命（NGHM）中包含的政策。虽然印度提供了实证基础，但该框架为其他发展中和新兴经济体提供了普遍的见解，在这些经济体中，模块化基础设施、混合金融、分阶段监管路径和机构能力建设对于克服分散的系统和加速 GH 的采用至关重要。通过推进经过验证的混合模型，这项研究有助于政策审查和决策支持分析，为加速氢转型提供全球相关指导。

articles.title_en: A critical review linking agrivoltaic technologies, agronomic outcomes and techno-economic viability for energy–water synergies
articles.title_cn: 将农业光伏技术、农艺成果和能源-水协同效应的技术经济可行性联系起来的批判性评论
articles.abstract_en: The increasing demand for renewable energy and food production has intensified competition for limited land resources, creating challenges for sustainable land-use management. Agrivoltaic systems (AVS), which integrate photovoltaic (PV) electricity generation with agricultural production on the same land area, have emerged as a promising approach to improve resource-use efficiency while supporting the Food–Energy–Water nexus. This study presents a PRISMA-based systematic review of agrivoltaic research published between 2010 and 2025 using Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Following a structured screening, eligibility assessment, and quality appraisal process, 125 studies were selected for detailed analysis. The reviewed literature was synthesised across five thematic domains: agrivoltaic system architectures, crop productivity and microclimate interactions, PV performance optimisation, land and water-use efficiency, and techno-economic and policy dimensions. The findings indicate that well-designed AVS can maintain or enhance crop productivity while simultaneously generating renewable electricity, improving microclimatic conditions, reducing evapotranspiration, and increasing water-use efficiency. Reported land equivalent ratio (LER) values often exceeded unity under appropriately designed AVS; however, outcomes varied considerably with crop type, climatic conditions, system configuration, and management practices. Critical evaluation of the literature revealed substantial heterogeneity in methodologies, performance indicators, and reporting practices, limiting direct comparison across studies. Despite significant progress, large-scale deployment remains constrained by technical complexity, high capital costs, regulatory uncertainties, and the lack of standardised assessment frameworks. Based on the synthesised evidence, this review proposes an integrated agrivoltaic design framework linking PV engineering, crop dynamics, water-resource management, and techno-economic evaluation, and identifies key research priorities for the development of resilient and scalable AVS.
articles.abstract_cn: 对可再生能源和粮食生产的需求不断增加，加剧了对有限土地资源的竞争，给可持续土地利用管理带来了挑战。农业光伏系统（AVS）将光伏（PV）发电与同一土地上的农业生产相结合，已成为提高资源利用效率同时支持粮食-能源-水关系的一种有前途的方法。本研究使用 Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 对 2010 和 2025 之间发表的农业光伏研究进行了基于 PRISMA 的系统综述。经过结构化筛选、资格评估和质量评估流程后，125 研究被选择进行详细分析。所审查的文献涵盖五个主题领域：农业光伏系统架构、作物生产力和小气候相互作用、光伏性能优化、土地和水利用效率以及技术经济和政策维度。研究结果表明，精心设计的 AVS 可以保持或提高作物生产力，同时产生可再生电力、改善小气候条件、减少蒸散量并提高用水效率。在适当设计的 AVS 下，报告的土地当量比 (LER) 值常常超过统一值；然而，结果因作物类型、气候条件、系统配置和管理实践而有很大差异。对文献的批判性评估揭示了方法、绩效指标和报告实践的显着异质性，限制了研究之间的直接比较。尽管取得了重大进展，但大规模部署仍然受到技术复杂性、高资本成本、监管不确定性和缺乏标准化评估框架的限制。基于综合证据，本综述提出了一个将光伏工程、作物动态、水资源管理和技术经济评估联系起来的综合农业光伏设计框架，并确定了开发弹性和可扩展的AVS的关键研究重点。

articles.title_en: Identification of technical design constraints and considerations for transmission grid expansion planning projects
articles.title_cn: 输电网络扩建项目规划中技术设计约束与考虑因素的识别
articles.abstract_en: The large-scale deployment of renewable energy sources, particularly offshore wind, requires large-scale transmission grid expansion projects to transmit the produced low-carbon power to the main demand centers. However, the planning and design of such complex projects currently lack a transparent and systematic process that system operators can follow when considering such investments in their grids. This paper identifies and classifies the main technical design constraints and considerations relevant to the planning of transmission grid expansion projects, and more specifically, electrical energy hubs. Seven key areas of interest are identified focusing mainly on European projects, namely network integration, HVDC technologies, costs (CAPEX, OPEX, and space requirements), electricity market design, future proofness and modular expandability, reliability-availability-maintainability, and sustainability. Each area of interest is analyzed in terms of its technical and operational relevance, with technical design constraints and considerations derived from such analysis. In addition, a hierarchical classification of the identified constraints and considerations (and therefore areas of interest) is introduced, distinguishing them between three criticality classes, namely hard constraints, main drivers, and key considerations. The dependencies between the different areas are discussed mainly for the European context, too. Therefore, this work provides system operators and policymakers with a structured basis to support a transparent planning methodology with clear decision hierarchies for investments in transmission grid expansion projects.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源的大规模部署，特别是海上风电，需要大规模的输电网络扩建项目，以将产生的低碳电力传输到主要需求中心。然而，此类复杂项目的规划和设计目前缺乏透明且系统的流程，系统运营商在考虑将其纳入电网投资时无法遵循。本文识别并分类了与输电网络扩建项目规划相关的主要技术设计约束和考虑因素，更具体地说是电气能源枢纽。确定了七个关键关注领域，主要聚焦于欧洲项目，即网络集成、高压直流输电技术、成本（资本支出、运营支出和空间需求）、电力市场设计、未来适应性和模块化可扩展性、可靠性-可用性-可维护性以及可持续性。每个关注领域都根据其技术和运营相关性进行分析，并从中得出技术设计约束和考虑因素。此外，引入了对所识别约束和考虑因素（因此也是关注领域）的层次分类，将其区分为三个关键性类别，即硬约束、主要驱动因素和关键考虑因素。不同领域之间的依赖关系也主要针对欧洲背景进行了讨论。因此，这项工作为系统运营商和政策制定者提供了结构化的基础，以支持透明的规划方法，并为输电网络扩建项目的投资提供明确的决策层级。

articles.title_en: Biocrude production via hydrothermal liquefaction of biomass: Recent advances and trends
articles.title_cn: 生物质水热液化生产生物原油：近期进展与趋势
articles.abstract_en: Hydrothermal liquefaction (HTL) appears as a promising way to convert biomass into biocrude, which, in turn, can be upgraded to advanced transportation biofuels. In the last ten years, research on HTL has significantly increased. The necessity for sustainable fuel alternatives originated from the updated EU RED III targets has triggered this growth. This review aims to present the recent progress in HTL by focusing on feedstock diversity, solvent selection, reaction mechanism, and process optimization. A plethora of biomass types has been studied so far, including lignocellulosic residues, municipal and industrial waste, sewage sludge, animal manure, microalgae, and oleaginous yeasts. This fact highlights HTL compatibility and its significant impact towards circular bioeconomy. Furthermore, the major biomass components (cellulose, hemicellulose, lignin, lipids, and proteins) are examined comparatively, along with how water, organic solvents, and co-solvent reaction mediums can impact product distribution and fuel quality. Also, important operational factors like temperature, residence time, reactor loading, pressure, and heating rate are examined concerning biocrude yield and quality. Subsequently, the review dives into studies engaged with extractant selection, catalyst development, aqueous phase recirculation, and the valorization of HTL byproducts. Finally, a summary of recent advances in upgrading methods, scaling up technology, economic analysis, and life cycle assessment is presented to evaluate HTL commercial readiness and sustainability. Overall, this review aims to collectively present all the recent active HTL studies and stress the next steps towards process escalation.
articles.abstract_cn: 水热液化（HTL）作为一种将生物质转化为生物原油的有前景的方法，而生物原油又可进一步升级为先进的交通生物燃料。在过去十年中，关于HTL的研究显著增加。对可持续燃料替代品的需求源于更新的欧盟RED III目标，这推动了这一增长。本综述旨在通过关注原料多样性、溶剂选择、反应机理和工艺优化来展示HTL的最新进展。迄今为止，已研究了多种生物质类型，包括木质纤维素残渣、市政和工业废物、污水污泥、动物粪便、微藻和产油酵母。这一事实突显了HTL的兼容性及其对循环生物经济的重大影响。此外，对主要生物质组分（纤维素、半纤维素、木质素、脂质和蛋白质）进行了比较研究，以及水、有机溶剂和共溶剂反应介质如何影响产物分布和燃料质量。同时，考察了温度、停留时间、反应器装载量、压力和加热速率等重要操作因素对生物原油产率和质量的影响。随后，综述深入探讨了涉及萃取剂选择、催化剂开发、水相再循环和HTL副产物增值的研究。最后，总结了升级方法、放大技术、经济分析和生命周期评估方面的近期进展，以评估HTL的商业准备度和可持续性。总体而言，本综述旨在全面呈现所有近期活跃的HTL研究，并强调迈向工艺放大的下一步措施。

articles.title_en: Hydrogen safety in production and storage: A critical review of materials–hydrogen interactions and intrinsically safe strategies
articles.title_cn: 生产与储存中的氢安全：材料-氢相互作用及本质安全策略的批判性综述
articles.abstract_en: Hydrogen safety forms the cornerstone of the entire hydrogen industry safety system. Unlike the leakage risks at the application end, the core risks in the production/storage process stem from the degradation and deterioration of materials under long-term hydrogen exposure. This review critically assesses the safety challenges and technological advances in water electrolysis and in gaseous, cryogenic, and solid-state hydrogen storage. In production, we examine multi-scale failure mechanisms across alkaline, PEM, anion exchange membrane, and solid oxide electrolysis, including strong alkali corrosion, gas-liquid separation imbalance, hydrogen crossover, and membrane degradation. In storage, we analyze hydrogen embrittlement, liner collapse, boil-off loss, thermal runaway, and particle pulverization, along with emerging mitigation strategies. From the existing studies, it can be seen that the material-hydrogen interaction over a long time scale is the main cause of safety risks, while the dynamic conditions introduced by the coupling of renewable energy sources further amplify the system risks through the multi-physics field coupling effect. Based on the review of the current research status, this paper summarizes the common challenges currently faced: the mismatch between the single mechanism research and the actual multi-physical field coupling scenarios, the scarcity of long-term dynamic verification data, and the insufficiency of online diagnosis capabilities for early failures. Accordingly, three priority research directions are proposed: the design of intrinsic safety materials, the system safety prediction and intelligent diagnosis framework for multi-physical field coupling, and the standardized accelerated testing procedures adapted to industrial needs.
articles.abstract_cn: 氢安全是整个氢能产业安全体系的基石。与应用端的泄漏风险不同，生产/储存过程中的核心风险源于材料在长期氢暴露下的退化与劣化。本综述批判性地评估了水电解以及气态、低温液态和固态储氢中的安全挑战与技术进展。在生产方面，我们考察了碱性、PEM、阴离子交换膜和固体氧化物电解中的多尺度失效机制，包括强碱腐蚀、气液分离失衡、氢交叉和膜退化。在储存方面，我们分析了氢脆、内衬塌陷、蒸发损失、热失控和颗粒粉化，以及新兴的缓解策略。从现有研究可以看出，长时间尺度上的材料-氢相互作用是安全风险的主要原因，而可再生能源耦合引入的动态条件通过多物理场耦合效应进一步放大了系统风险。基于对当前研究现状的综述，本文总结了当前面临的共同挑战：单一机制研究与实际多物理场耦合场景之间的不匹配、长期动态验证数据的稀缺，以及早期故障在线诊断能力的不足。据此，提出了三个优先研究方向：本质安全材料的设计、多物理场耦合的系统安全预测与智能诊断框架，以及适应工业需求的标准化加速测试程序。

articles.title_en: Evidence for a new subtype of harvest-time granulation in 'Dongshizao' pomelo with pectin-dominated cell wall remodeling but no significant lignin accumulation
articles.title_cn: ‘东市早’柚采收期粒化新亚型的证据：以果胶为主的细胞壁重塑但无显著木质素积累
articles.abstract_en: Juice sac granulation severely impairs citrus postharvest quality, yet it remains unclear whether granulation already evident at harvest is governed by the same cell wall metabolic disorder described during storage. Here, ‘Dongshizao’ pomelo, which displays granulated juice sacs predominantly at the stem end while equatorial tissues remain normal at harvest, was used to investigate the biochemical and molecular basis of this spatial heterogeneity. Physiological measurements were integrated with transcriptomic, untargeted metabolomic, and targeted phytohormone analyses. Compared with equatorial normal juice sacs, stem-end granulated sacs had lower total soluble solids, titratable acidity, and juice yield, whereas relative water content was unchanged. Protopectin content and pectin methylesterase activity increased by 11.4% and 72.9%, respectively, while polygalacturonase activity decreased by 41.5%, indicating enhanced pectin demethylesterification and restricted pectin degradation. Cellulose biosynthesis-related genes, including CgCesA8, were transcriptionally activated. Although lignin-pathway genes, particularly LAC and PRX family members, were induced, lignin content and most detected pathway intermediates did not increase significantly. Multi-omics integration further indicated coordinated reprogramming of sucrose and citrate metabolism, together with increased abscisic acid and decreased jasmonate-related metabolites. Co-expression analyses identified CgERF109, CgERF99, CgbHLH122, CgMYB4, and CgMYB52 as candidate regulators linking cell wall remodeling with sugar–acid metabolism. These findings support the “Disorder of cell wall metabolism” hypothesis and identify a distinct subtype of granulation evident at harvest, characterized by pronounced pectin remodeling without substantial lignin accumulation, thereby providing a potential mechanistic basis for regulating its subsequent postharvest progression during commercial storage and transportation.
articles.abstract_cn: 汁胞粒化严重损害柑橘采后品质，然而，采收时已明显粒化是否受贮藏期间所描述的相同细胞壁代谢紊乱调控仍不清楚。本研究以‘东市早’柚为材料，其在采收时汁胞粒化主要发生在茎端，而赤道部组织保持正常，用以探究这种空间异质性的生化和分子基础。生理测量与转录组学、非靶向代谢组学和靶向植物激素分析相结合。与赤道部正常汁胞相比，茎端粒化汁胞的总可溶性固形物、可滴定酸度和出汁率较低，而相对含水量不变。原果胶含量和果胶甲酯酶活性分别增加11.4%和72.9%，而多聚半乳糖醛酸酶活性降低41.5%，表明果胶去甲酯化增强和果胶降解受限。纤维素生物合成相关基因，包括CgCesA8，在转录水平被激活。尽管木质素途径基因，特别是LAC和PRX家族成员被诱导，但木质素含量和大多数检测到的途径中间产物并未显著增加。多组学整合进一步表明蔗糖和柠檬酸代谢的协调重编程，同时脱落酸增加和茉莉酸相关代谢物减少。共表达分析确定CgERF109、CgERF99、CgbHLH122、CgMYB4和CgMYB52为连接细胞壁重塑与糖酸代谢的候选调控因子。这些发现支持“细胞壁代谢紊乱”假说，并识别出一种采收时明显的粒化亚型，其特征为显著的果胶重塑而无大量木质素积累，从而为其在商业贮藏和运输过程中的后续采后进程调控提供了潜在的机制基础。

articles.title_en: Protamine peptide-enhanced pectin composite gel beads for efficient gastrointestinal-responsive anthocyanin release
articles.title_cn: 鱼精蛋白肽增强果胶复合凝胶珠用于高效胃肠道响应性花青素释放
articles.abstract_en: Pectin–calcium gels are widely used as carriers for food bioactives, but their strong dependence on Ca2+-mediated crosslinking creates a trade-off between structural stability and intestinal release. High Ca2+ levels strengthen the gel network but can hinder the release of anthocyanins, which are mainly absorbed in the small intestine, whereas reducing Ca2+ may compromise gel integrity. In this study, protamine peptide was incorporated into a pectin-based gel matrix to improve intestinal responsiveness while maintaining structural stability at reduced Ca2+ levels. Complementary zeta-potential, ITC, DSC, FTIR, and XPS analyses supported spontaneous association between pectin and protamine peptide, primarily involving electrostatic association and hydrogen bonding. These additional interactions were associated, at least in part, with the maintenance of gel integrity, and formulation 16 exhibited a hardness of 1.15 N at 0.5% Ca2+. The composite gel beads retained their structure under simulated gastric conditions but underwent marked disintegration in simulated intestinal fluid (SIF). Formulation 16 achieved an intestinal-phase anthocyanin release of 68.20%, more than twice that of the conventional pectin–Ca2+ control beads. Kinetic analysis indicated that limited gastric release was mainly governed by diffusion, whereas enhanced intestinal release resulted from the combined effects of gel disintegration and diffusion. These findings demonstrate the potential of pectin–protamine peptide gel beads as gastrointestinal-responsive carriers for anthocyanins and other food bioactives.
articles.abstract_cn: 果胶-钙凝胶被广泛用作食品生物活性物质的载体，但其对Ca2+介导交联的强烈依赖性在结构稳定性与肠道释放之间产生了权衡。高Ca2+水平强化了凝胶网络，但可能阻碍主要在十二指肠吸收的花青素的释放，而降低Ca2+则可能损害凝胶完整性。在本研究中，将鱼精蛋白肽掺入果胶基凝胶基质中，以在降低Ca2+水平下提高肠道响应性，同时维持结构稳定性。互补的zeta电位、ITC、DSC、FTIR和XPS分析支持果胶与鱼精蛋白肽之间的自发结合，主要涉及静电结合和氢键作用。这些额外的相互作用至少部分与凝胶完整性的维持相关，配方16在0.5%Ca2+下表现出1.15 N的硬度。复合凝胶珠在模拟胃液条件下保持其结构，但在模拟肠液（SIF）中发生显著崩解。配方16实现了68.20%的肠道阶段花青素释放，是传统果胶-Ca2+对照珠的两倍以上。动力学分析表明，有限的胃释放主要由扩散控制，而增强的肠道释放则是凝胶崩解和扩散共同作用的结果。这些发现证明了果胶-鱼精蛋白肽凝胶珠作为花青素及其他食品生物活性物质的胃肠道响应性载体的潜力。

articles.title_en: Transcriptomic analysis of Shiga toxin-producing <ce:italic>Escherichia coli</ce:italic> O157:H7 on alfalfa sprouts: Broad adaptive responses during colonization and minimal change during refrigerated storage
articles.title_cn: 苜蓿芽上产生志贺毒素<ce:italic>大肠杆菌</ce:italic> O157:H7的转录组分析：定植期间广泛的适应性反应和冷藏期间的最小变化
articles.abstract_en: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) is a major foodborne pathogen associated with raw produce such as sprouts, where it encounters variable nutrient, temperature, and oxidative stress. This study elucidated the transcriptional adaptations of E. coli O157:H7 EDL933 during colonization and persistence on alfalfa sprouts under simulated commercial sprouting and refrigerated storage. RNA-sequencing was used to compare STEC grown in tryptic soy broth (TSB) (D0), colonized sprouts for 5 days (D5), and held for 3 days under refrigeration (D8). Among 5002 expressed genes, 782 and 826 were differentially expressed (DEGs; |log2FC| ≥ 2, adjusted p < 0.05) at D5 vs. D0, and D8 vs. D0, respectively, whereas 11 genes differed in the D8 vs. D5 comparison, indicating minimal shifts during refrigeration. Transition of STEC from TSB to sprouts tissues up-regulated de novo amino acid biosynthesis (hisA–H, leuABCD, and ilv operons), to compensate for nitrogen limitation within sprouts tissues. In sprouts environments, STEC induced high-affinity uptake systems for potassium (kdpA/B/C/F), phosphorus (pstSCAB), and sulfur (tauABCD), alongside enterobactin-mediated iron acquisition. To survive in the sprouts' microenvironment, STEC elevated the transcription of acid resistance (gadA/C, cadA/B), oxidative stress defense (sodA, katE/G), and envelope protection (degP, pspA–D, baeS) genes. Functional enrichment at D5 and D8, compared to D0, indicated coordinated stress regulation and translation. Major transcriptional trends observed in RNA-seq were confirmed using RT-qPCR. Collectively, these findings highlight a broad transcriptional reprogramming, primarily during alfalfa sprout colonization, with the transcriptome stabilized by D5 of sprouting whereas refrigeration (D5-D8) induced only minimal cold-induced changes. These findings provide insights that could be translated into STEC risk mitigation during sprouts production.
articles.abstract_cn: 产生志贺毒素的大肠杆菌 (STEC) 是一种与豆芽等生产品相关的主要食源性病原体，它会遇到不同的营养、温度和氧化应激。本研究阐明了大肠杆菌 O157:H7 EDL933 在模拟商业发芽和冷藏条件下在苜蓿芽上定植和持久存在的转录适应性。 RNA 测序用于比较在胰蛋白酶大豆肉汤 (TSB) (D0) 中生长的 STEC、定植芽苗 5 天 (D5) 和冷藏 3 天 (D8)。在5002表达的基因中，782和826分别在D5与D0和D8与D0差异表达（DEG；|log2FC|≥2，调整p <0.05），而11基因在D8与D8与D0差异表达。 D5比较，表明冷藏期间的变化最小。 STEC 从 TSB 到豆芽组织的转变上调了从头氨基酸生物合成（hisA-H、leuABCD 和 ilv 操纵子），以补偿豆芽组织内的氮限制。在豆芽环境中，STEC 诱导钾 (kdpA/B/C/F)、磷 (pstSCAB) 和硫 (tauABCD) 的高亲和力吸收系统，以及肠杆菌素介导的铁吸收。为了在豆芽的微环境中生存，STEC 提高了耐酸性（gadA/C、cadA/B）、氧化应激防御（sodA、katE/G）和包膜保护（degP、pspA–D、baeS）基因的转录。与 D0 相比，D5 和 D8 的功能富集表明协调的应激调节和翻译。使用 RT-qPCR 确认了 RNA-seq 中观察到的主要转录趋势。总的来说，这些发现强调了广泛的转录重编程，主要是在苜蓿芽定植期间，转录组通过发芽的D5稳定，而冷藏（D5-D8）仅诱导最小的冷诱导变化。这些发现提供了可转化为豆芽生产过程中 STEC 风险缓解的见解。

articles.title_en: Advancements in the research of antioxidant peptides: A comprehensive overview
articles.title_cn: 抗氧化肽研究进展：全面概述
articles.abstract_en: Oxidative stress can trigger apoptosis, tissue damage, and the onset of various chronic diseases. By maintaining cellular homeostasis, antioxidants can effectively reduce the risk of diseases associated with oxidative damage, including cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative diseases, and metabolic disorders. Given the drawbacks associated with synthetic antioxidants, there has been a gradual shift toward natural alternatives. Antioxidant peptides, derived from proteins, have emerged as natural antioxidants possessing numerous advantages, including abundant sources, high safety profiles, and easy absorption. This article provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in antioxidant peptide research, with particular emphasis on bioinformatics-assisted discovery and in silico screening approaches, alongside their sources, preparation methods, antioxidant mechanisms, and biological evaluation methods. In addition, this paper explores the current applications of antioxidant peptides in functional foods and the prevention of oxidative stress-related diseases and outlines future trends in this field, thereby providing valuable guidance for the further development and utilization of antioxidant peptides.
articles.abstract_cn: 氧化应激可触发细胞凋亡、组织损伤及多种慢性疾病的发生。通过维持细胞稳态，抗氧化剂能有效降低与氧化损伤相关疾病的风险，包括心血管疾病、神经退行性疾病和代谢紊乱。鉴于合成抗氧化剂的缺点，人们逐渐转向天然替代品。源自蛋白质的抗氧化肽已成为天然抗氧化剂，具有来源丰富、安全性高、易于吸收等众多优点。本文全面概述了抗氧化肽研究的最新进展，特别强调了生物信息学辅助发现和计算机模拟筛选方法，以及其来源、制备方法、抗氧化机制和生物学评价方法。此外，本文探讨了抗氧化肽在功能性食品和预防氧化应激相关疾病中的当前应用，并概述了该领域的未来趋势，从而为进一步开发和利用抗氧化肽提供有价值的指导。

articles.title_en: NADES-mediated glycation of casein with mannose and mannose-oligosaccharides: conformation, antioxidant activity, and antimicrobial activity of gastrointestinal digests
articles.title_cn: NADES介导的酪蛋白与甘露糖及甘露寡糖的糖基化：胃肠道消化产物的构象、抗氧化活性和抗菌活性
articles.abstract_en: This study aimed to improve the physicochemical and functional properties of casein (CN) via glycation based on natural deep eutectic solvents (NADES). Four glycated CN conjugates (CN-Man1, CN-Man2, CN-Mos1, and CN-Mos2) were prepared with mannose (Man) or mannose-oligosaccharides (Mos) in water and NADES systems under optimized conditions. Structural and physicochemical changes were analyzed. The results indicated that Mos-mediated glycation in NADES was associated with marked conformational changes, and CN-Mos2 exhibited the lowest surface hydrophobicity and the highest thermal stability. Additionally, functional properties including solubility, antioxidant activities, digestibility, and antibacterial activity were evaluated. Glycation was associated with the enhanced functional properties of CN, and these effects varied depending on the sugar type and reaction system. CN-Man2 displayed the highest intracellular and extracellular antioxidant activities, and its digests also possessed the strongest in vitro antibacterial activity. These findings suggest that glycation may induce structural changes in CN, which in turn could modulate its functional properties, providing a preliminary basis for its potential application in functional foods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在通过基于天然深共熔溶剂（NADES）的糖基化改善酪蛋白（CN）的理化及功能特性。在优化条件下，于水和NADES体系中分别制备了四种糖基化CN缀合物（CN-Man1、CN-Man2、CN-Mos1和CN-Mos2），所用糖类为甘露糖（Man）或甘露寡糖（Mos）。分析了结构和理化变化。结果表明，在NADES中由Mos介导的糖基化与显著的构象变化相关，且CN-Mos2表现出最低的表面疏水性和最高的热稳定性。此外，还评估了包括溶解度、抗氧化活性、消化率和抗菌活性在内的功能特性。糖基化与CN功能特性的增强相关，且这些效应因糖类型和反应体系的不同而异。CN-Man2表现出最高的细胞内和细胞外抗氧化活性，其消化产物也拥有最强的体外抗菌活性。这些发现表明，糖基化可能诱导CN的结构变化，进而调节其功能特性，为其在功能性食品中的潜在应用提供了初步基础。

articles.title_en: Food-derived extracellular vesicles: processing sensitivity, structural integrity, and implications for dietary bioactivity
articles.title_cn: 食物来源的细胞外囊泡：加工敏感性、结构完整性及其对膳食生物活性的影响
articles.abstract_en: Food-derived extracellular vesicles (FDEVs) are nanoscale membrane-bound structures naturally present in plant- and animal-derived foods, carrying diverse bioactive components including lipids, proteins, small RNAs, and metabolites. Increasing evidence suggests that FDEVs may contribute to dietary bioactivity; however, their physiological relevance remains difficult to establish due to the limited understanding of how food processing and gastrointestinal conditions influence their biological functions.Recent studies have highlighted that food processing can reshape multiple aspects of FDEV properties, including membrane integrity, particle characteristics, aggregation behavior, and cargos accessibility. These processing-induced alterations may determine the stability, transformation, and biological availability of FDEVs during gastrointestinal digestion and subsequent interactions with host tissues and microbiota. Nevertheless, current investigations often examine processing effects, digestive fate, and biological outcomes in separate experimental systems, resulting in a lack of integrated understanding of structure–function relationships under physiologically relevant conditions.This review critically evaluates the current knowledge regarding the impact of food processing on FDEV structure, gastrointestinal fate, and potential bioactivities. Particular attention is given to the challenges associated with dose relevance, vesicle characterization, biodistribution assessment, and the interpretation of cargos-mediated effects. By integrating evidence across processing, digestion, and biological response studies, this review proposes a processing–digestion–bioactivity framework as a conceptual model for organizing current evidence, identifying knowledge gaps, and guiding future studies toward physiologically meaningful mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 食物来源的细胞外囊泡（FDEVs）是天然存在于植物和动物源性食物中的纳米级膜结合结构，携带多种生物活性成分，包括脂质、蛋白质、小RNA和代谢物。越来越多的证据表明，FDEVs可能有助于膳食生物活性；然而，由于对食品加工和胃肠条件如何影响其生物学功能的理解有限，其生理相关性仍难以确定。近期研究强调，食品加工可以重塑FDEVs特性的多个方面，包括膜完整性、颗粒特征、聚集行为和货物可及性。这些加工引起的改变可能决定FDEVs在胃肠消化过程中及其随后与宿主组织和微生物群相互作用时的稳定性、转化和生物可利用性。尽管如此，当前的研究往往在独立的实验系统中考察加工效应、消化命运和生物学结果，导致在生理相关条件下缺乏对结构-功能关系的综合理解。本综述批判性地评估了关于食品加工对FDEVs结构、胃肠命运和潜在生物活性影响的现有知识。特别关注与剂量相关性、囊泡表征、生物分布评估以及货物介导效应解释相关的挑战。通过整合加工、消化和生物反应研究的证据，本综述提出了一个加工-消化-生物活性框架，作为组织现有证据、识别知识空白并指导未来研究朝向生理相关机制的概念模型。

articles.title_en: <ce:italic>Calvatia lilacina</ce:italic> spores extract and engineered <ce:italic>E. coli</ce:italic> Nissle 1917 remodel the diabetic wound microenvironment through combined treatment
articles.title_cn: Calvatia lilacina孢子提取物与工程化大肠杆菌Nissle 1917通过联合治疗重塑糖尿病创面微环境
articles.abstract_en: Diabetic wound healing is severely impaired by persistent inflammation and microbial dysbiosis. The study presents a combinedfunctional ingredient system centered on an engineered thymidine-auxotrophic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 strain (ThyA−/−-EcN), whose survival and activity are sustained by the thymidine naturally present in Calvatia lilacina spore extract (CLSE). CLSE was chemically characterized by UHPLC-QTOF-MS, and its thymidine content was quantified as 4.1 mg/g by HPLC. In a full-thickness excisional wound model in diabetic db/db mice, CLSE alone accelerated wound healing, enhanced re-epithelialization and collagen deposition, and restructured the wound microbiota by increasing Escherichia-Shigella while suppressing Staphylococcus (SA). Notably, the combination of CLSE and ThyA−/−-EcN significantly prolonged the colonization of the engineered probiotic in vivo compared to ThyA−/−-EcN alone, an effect we hypothesize to be attributable, at least in part, to the thymidine provided by CLSE. This prolonged colonization, in combination with CLSE, boosted M2 macrophage polarization, enhanced fibroblast function, and strengthened the suppression of SA, which our in vitro data suggest may involve nutrient competition. The results demonstrate that CLSE not only directly improves wound healing but also acts as a natural thymidine delivery vehicle to unlock the full potential of ThyA−/−-EcN, establishing a rationale for developing a food-derived bioactive extract-assisted live biotherapeutic strategy.
articles.abstract_cn: 糖尿病创面愈合因持续炎症和微生物失调而严重受损。本研究提出了一种以工程化胸苷营养缺陷型大肠杆菌Nissle 1917菌株（ThyA−/−-EcN）为核心的综合功能性成分系统，其存活和活性由Calvatia lilacina孢子提取物（CLSE）中天然存在的胸苷维持。通过UHPLC-QTOF-MS对CLSE进行化学表征，并通过HPLC定量其胸苷含量为4.1 mg/g。在糖尿病db/db小鼠的全层切除创面模型中，单独使用CLSE可加速创面愈合，增强再上皮化和胶原沉积，并通过增加大肠杆菌-志贺菌属同时抑制葡萄球菌属（SA）来重塑创面微生物群。值得注意的是，与单独使用ThyA−/−-EcN相比，CLSE与ThyA−/−-EcN的组合显著延长了工程化益生菌在体内的定植时间，我们假设这一效应至少部分归因于CLSE提供的胸苷。这种延长的定植与CLSE结合，促进了M2巨噬细胞极化，增强了成纤维细胞功能，并加强了对SA的抑制，我们的体外数据表明这可能涉及营养竞争。结果表明，CLSE不仅直接改善创面愈合，还作为天然胸苷递送载体，释放ThyA−/−-EcN的全部潜力，为开发食品来源的生物活性提取物辅助的活体生物治疗策略提供了依据。

articles.title_en: Efficient degradation of aflatoxin B1 by <ce:italic>Arthrobacter citreus</ce:italic> Soilh02: Characterization, degradation products, and detoxification mechanism
articles.title_cn: 柠檬节杆菌Soilh02对黄曲霉毒素B1的高效降解：特性、降解产物及解毒机制
articles.abstract_en: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) is a highly toxic mycotoxin prevalent in food and feed that poses a grave threat to human and animal health. In this study, an AFB1- degrading strain of Arthrobacter citreus, designated Soilh02, was isolated. Under optimal conditions (37 °C, pH 8.0, 72 h), the presence of Cu2+ significantly enhanced AFB1 degradation, achieving a maximum degradation rate of 93.96%. Ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-QTOF) identified two novel degradation products with molecular formulas C18H 20O7 and C16H14O6, and proposed plausible structures for these compounds based on accurate mass data and fragmentation pathways. Subsequently, ultrafiltration, DE52 anion-exchange chromatography, activity assays, and SDS-PAGE were used to isolate and purify the extracellular proteins responsible for AFB1 degradation. LC-MS/MS and molecular docking analyses suggested that oxidoreductase RE1 may participate in AFB1 degradation, as its activity was markedly suppressed by inhibitors. RE1 bound AFB1 with a binding energy of −8.511 kcal/mol and was capable of degrading its difuran, lactone, and cyclopentenone ring via Lys-210, Arg-422, and Phe-427. Overall, this study provides a high-quality microbial resource and a theoretical basis for developing efficient and eco-friendly AFB1 biodegradation strategies. These findings offer significant potential for enhancing food and feed safety and promoting sustainable agricultural practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）是一种高毒性霉菌毒素，普遍存在于食品和饲料中，对人类和动物健康构成严重威胁。本研究分离出一株能够降解AFB1的柠檬节杆菌菌株，命名为Soilh02。在最佳条件下（37°C，pH 8.0，72小时），Cu2+的存在显著增强了AFB1的降解，最高降解率达到93.96%。超高效液相色谱-串联质谱（UHPLC-QTOF）鉴定出两种新的降解产物，分子式分别为C18H20O7和C16H14O6，并根据精确质量数据和碎裂途径提出了这些化合物的可能结构。随后，采用超滤、DE52阴离子交换色谱、活性测定和SDS-PAGE分离纯化了负责AFB1降解的胞外蛋白。LC-MS/MS和分子对接分析表明，氧化还原酶RE1可能参与AFB1的降解，因为其活性受到抑制剂的显著抑制。RE1与AFB1的结合能为-8.511 kcal/mol，并能够通过Lys-210、Arg-422和Phe-427降解其二呋喃环、内酯环和环戊烯酮环。总体而言，本研究为开发高效、环保的AFB1生物降解策略提供了高质量的微生物资源和理论基础。这些发现对于提高食品和饲料安全性以及促进可持续农业实践具有重要潜力。

articles.title_en: <ce:italic>Lactobacillus casei</ce:italic> 1.0351 as an adjunct culture in Cheddar cheese: Modulation of bioactive peptide release and bacterial community dynamics
articles.title_cn: 干酪乳杆菌 1.0351 作为切达干酪的辅助发酵剂：对生物活性肽释放和细菌群落动态的调节
articles.abstract_en: This study investigated the effect of adding Lactobacillus casei 1.0351 as an auxiliary strain on the release of antioxidant peptides in Cheddar cheese during a 32-week maturation period. Compared with the control group, the addition of L.casei 1.0351 resulted in higher protein hydrolysis and antioxidant activity in the cheese, with the L.casei group reaching a significant peak at week 28. Furthermore, peptide fractions with a molecular weight of less than 3 kDa exhibited the highest antioxidant activity. Compared with the control group, the L.casei group had a greater number of cleavage sites; the sequenced peptide fragments were mainly derived from αS1-casein and β-casein, and were predominantly short-chain peptides (<20 amino acids). Six antioxidant peptides with 100% homology were identified in cheese supplemented with L.casei 1.0351: αS1-CN f(90–92) (RYL), αS1-CN f(91–94) (YLGY), β-CN f(193–196) (YQEP), β-CN f(169–176) (KVLPVPQK), β-CN f(59–68) (VYPFPGPIPN), and β-CN f(78–91) (TQTPVVVVPPFLQPE). Microbiome analysis revealed that L.casei 1.0351 reshaped the microbial community, increasing the abundance of the Lactococcus, suggesting that microbial community succession plays a key role in shaping the peptide profile. Overall, L. casei 1.0351 promotes the hydrolysis of casein and the formation of bioactive peptides such as antioxidant peptides, providing a theoretical basis for the development of functional cheese products.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在 32 周成熟期间，添加干酪乳杆菌 1.0351 作为辅助菌株对切达干酪中抗氧化肽释放的影响。与对照组相比，添加干酪乳杆菌 1.0351 的干酪表现出更高的蛋白质水解程度和抗氧化活性，其中干酪乳杆菌组在第 28 周达到显著峰值。此外，分子量小于 3 kDa 的肽组分显示出最高的抗氧化活性。与对照组相比，干酪乳杆菌组具有更多的切割位点；测序的肽片段主要来源于 αS1-酪蛋白和 β-酪蛋白，且主要为短链肽（<20 个氨基酸）。在添加干酪乳杆菌 1.0351 的干酪中鉴定出六个具有 100% 同源性的抗氧化肽：αS1-CN f(90-92) (RYL)、αS1-CN f(91-94) (YLGY)、β-CN f(193-196) (YQEP)、β-CN f(169-176) (KVLPVPQK)、β-CN f(59-68) (VYPFPGPIPN) 和 β-CN f(78-91) (TQTPVVVVPPFLQPE)。微生物组分析显示，干酪乳杆菌 1.0351 重塑了微生物群落，增加了乳球菌属的丰度，表明微生物群落演替在塑造肽谱中起着关键作用。总体而言，干酪乳杆菌 1.0351 促进了酪蛋白的水解和生物活性肽（如抗氧化肽）的形成，为功能性干酪产品的开发提供了理论基础。

articles.title_en: Grid-forming energy storage in renewable-dominated power systems: An energy–impedance–dynamics perspective on control strategies, stability boundaries, and system applications
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源主导电力系统中的构网型储能：控制策略、稳定性边界与系统应用的能量-阻抗-动力学视角
articles.abstract_en: The increasing penetration of renewable energy and the gradual displacement of synchronous machines are reshaping the dynamic characteristics of modern power systems, making low inertia, weak-grid stability, and converter-grid interaction increasingly critical. Grid-forming energy storage (GFM-ES) is regarded as an important resource for voltage formation, frequency support, and system restoration. However, existing reviews are often organized around controller types, such as droop control, virtual synchronous generator/machine control, virtual oscillator control, and matching control. They provide limited synthesis of how storage-side energy reserve, port-impedance interaction, current-limiting degradation, and synchronization continuity jointly define practical grid-forming capability. Rather than proposing the energy-impedance-dynamics (EID) perspective as a new theory or control method, this review uses it as a critical synthesis framework to examine control strategies, stability boundaries, data-assisted enhancement, and system applications. The review shows that the value of this technology cannot be inferred from controller name or rated capacity alone; it must be confirmed through energy availability, impedance compatibility, synchronization continuity, protection coordination, and engineering validation. Data-assisted and physics-informed methods are better positioned as tools for boundary awareness, parameter recommendation, supervisory coordination, and offline validation, rather than substitutes for deterministic inner-loop control and protection logic. Future research should focus on energy-aware control, impedance-compatible design, post-fault resynchronization, standardized testing, and planning and market mechanisms for grid-forming services.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源渗透率的不断提高以及同步发电机的逐步替代正在重塑现代电力系统的动态特性，使得低惯量、弱电网稳定性以及变流器与电网之间的相互作用日益关键。构网型储能（GFM-ES）被视为电压形成、频率支持和系统恢复的重要资源。然而，现有综述通常围绕控制器类型进行组织，如下垂控制、虚拟同步发电机/电机控制、虚拟振荡器控制和匹配控制。它们对储能侧能量储备、端口阻抗相互作用、限流降级和同步连续性如何共同定义实际构网能力的综合阐述有限。本文并非将能量-阻抗-动力学（EID）视角作为一种新理论或控制方法提出，而是将其作为批判性综合框架，用于审视控制策略、稳定性边界、数据辅助增强和系统应用。综述表明，该技术的价值不能仅从控制器名称或额定容量推断，必须通过能量可用性、阻抗兼容性、同步连续性、保护协调和工程验证来确认。数据辅助和物理信息方法更适合作为边界感知、参数推荐、监督协调和离线验证的工具，而非替代确定性内环控制和保护逻辑。未来研究应聚焦于能量感知控制、阻抗兼容设计、故障后再同步、标准化测试以及构网型服务的规划和市场机制。

articles.title_en: The future of supply chain management in Industry 5.0: Emerging challenges and strategic opportunities
articles.title_cn: 工业5.0时代供应链管理的未来：新兴挑战与战略机遇
articles.abstract_en: Supply Chain Management (SCM) plays a critical role in integrating suppliers, manufacturers, transporters, and customers to ensure the efficient delivery of products and services. However, traditional supply chains often suffer from limitations, including overstocking, delivery delays, and a lack of real-time visibility. With the emergence of Industry 5.0, there is a growing need for resilient, sustainable, and human-centric SCM systems. This study aims to provide a comprehensive review of the evolution of SCM within the Industry 5.0 paradigm by examining key enabling technologies, architectures, and application scenarios. A structured literature review approach is adopted, focusing on recent contributions in the domain of intelligent supply chains, including technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), blockchain, and edge computing. The analysis highlights that Industry 5.0-driven SCM enhances operational efficiency through real-time data visibility, predictive analytics, and improved coordination across supply chain entities. Furthermore, architectural frameworks and use-case scenarios demonstrate how intelligent supply chains can support cost optimization, agile decision-making, and improved service delivery. The study also identifies critical challenges, including interoperability, data security, infrastructure limitations, and workforce transformation, and outlines future research directions to address these issues.
articles.abstract_cn: 供应链管理在整合供应商、制造商、运输商和客户以确保产品和服务的高效交付方面发挥着关键作用。然而，传统供应链常常存在局限性，包括库存积压、交付延迟以及缺乏实时可见性。随着工业5.0的出现，对具有韧性、可持续性和以人为本的供应链管理系统的需求日益增长。本研究旨在通过考察关键使能技术、架构和应用场景，全面回顾工业5.0范式下供应链管理的演变。采用结构化文献综述方法，聚焦智能供应链领域的最新贡献，包括物联网、人工智能、机器学习、区块链和边缘计算等技术。分析强调，工业5.0驱动的供应链管理通过实时数据可见性、预测分析和跨供应链实体的协调改进，提升了运营效率。此外，架构框架和使用案例场景展示了智能供应链如何支持成本优化、敏捷决策和改进服务交付。研究还识别了关键挑战，包括互操作性、数据安全、基础设施限制和劳动力转型，并概述了解决这些问题的未来研究方向。

articles.title_en: A unified mechanistic understanding of nanoporous membranes in osmotic energy conversion and selective separation
articles.title_cn: 纳米多孔膜在渗透能转换与选择性分离中的统一机理解释
articles.abstract_en: Nanoporous membranes stand at the forefront of addressing the global water-energy nexus. However, the intrinsic trade-off between permeability and selectivity limits their widespread application. Although existing studies have examined salt rejection, ionic current rectification, and osmotic power generation, these findings are often discussed separately. Through a structured screening of studies published from 2010 to 2026 and retrieved from Web of Science, Scopus, and Google Scholar, this review bridges these fragmented findings by establishing a unified mechanistic understanding of ion transport in nanoporous membranes. From 2D materials to rigid porous frameworks, advancing material platforms offer strategic pathways to mitigate traditional performance trade-offs. Key regulating factors governing selectivity, rectification, and osmotic power output are summarized into pore architecture, interfacial charge regulation, and coupled operating gradients. Thermo-chemical gradients can enhance performance, but the effects depend strongly on their alignment with concentration gradients and geometric asymmetry. An osmotic power efficiency map is further discussed to compare operating regimes and guide membrane design. Several challenges remain unresolved, including quantitative optimization of spatial charge distributions, complex electrolyte environments, and membrane-scale translation. Future research should integrate material design, coupled multiphysics control, and membrane scale validation to develop robust nanoporous membranes for blue energy harvesting and water purification.
articles.abstract_cn: 纳米多孔膜处于解决全球水-能源关系的前沿。然而，渗透性与选择性之间的内在权衡限制了其广泛应用。尽管现有研究已考察了盐截留、离子电流整流和渗透发电，但这些发现往往被分开讨论。通过对2010年至2026年间发表并从Web of Science、Scopus和Google Scholar检索的研究进行结构化筛选，本综述通过建立纳米多孔膜中离子传输的统一机理解释，弥合了这些分散的发现。从二维材料到刚性多孔框架，先进的材料平台提供了缓解传统性能权衡的战略途径。控制选择性、整流和渗透功率输出的关键调控因素被归纳为孔结构、界面电荷调控和耦合操作梯度。热化学梯度可以增强性能，但其效果强烈依赖于与浓度梯度和几何不对称性的对齐。进一步讨论了渗透功率效率图，以比较操作区间并指导膜设计。若干挑战仍未解决，包括空间电荷分布的定量优化、复杂电解质环境和膜尺度转化。未来研究应整合材料设计、耦合多物理场控制和膜尺度验证，以开发用于蓝色能源收集和水净化的稳健纳米多孔膜。

articles.title_en: Molecular mechanism and antibrowning efficacy of ellagic acid as a mixed-type inhibitor of rambutan polyphenol oxidase
articles.title_cn: 鞣花酸作为红毛丹多酚氧化酶混合型抑制剂的分子机制及抗褐变效果
articles.abstract_en: Enzymatic browning, mainly driven by polyphenol oxidase (PPO), significantly reduces the postharvest quality of rambutan fruit. In response to increasing safety concerns regarding synthetic inhibitors, this study evaluates ellagic acid (EA), a natural polyphenol compound, as a potential inhibitor of rambutan peel PPO and elucidates its inhibitory mechanism. Purified PPO from rambutan peel was used to characterize the inhibitory effects of EA through kinetic analysis, fluorescence spectroscopy, molecular docking, and in vivo validation. EA exhibited potent inhibitory activity against PPO, with an IC50 value of 0.042 mg mL−1, and was identified as a reversible mixed-type inhibitor. Kinetic analysis showed that the free enzyme had a higher affinity than for the enzyme-substrate complex (KI < KIS), indicating preferential binding to the native enzyme state. Fluorescence analysis confirmed that EA formed a stable complex with PPO via a static quenching mechanism, primarily driven by hydrophobic interactions. This interaction induced significant conformational changes in PPO and increased structural flexibility. Molecular docking further showed that EA stably docked within the active site, interacting with key copper-binding residues (His335 and His339), thereby generating steric hindrance that restricted substrate access. In vivo validation showed that EA treatment delayed pericarp browning, suppressed PPO and POD activities, and preserved fruit appearance during storage. These results provide mechanistic insights into PPO inhibition by EA and demonstrate its effectiveness in delaying enzymatic browning in postharvest rambutan fruit.
articles.abstract_cn: 酶促褐变主要由多酚氧化酶（PPO）驱动，显著降低红毛丹果实的采后品质。鉴于对合成抑制剂安全性日益增长的担忧，本研究评估了天然多酚化合物鞣花酸（EA）作为红毛丹果皮PPO潜在抑制剂的效果，并阐明其抑制机制。使用从红毛丹果皮纯化的PPO，通过动力学分析、荧光光谱、分子对接和体内验证来表征EA的抑制效果。EA对PPO表现出强效抑制活性，IC50值为0.042 mg mL−1，并被鉴定为可逆混合型抑制剂。动力学分析显示，游离酶对底物的亲和力高于酶-底物复合物（KI < KIS），表明其优先结合天然酶状态。荧光分析证实，EA通过静态猝灭机制与PPO形成稳定复合物，主要由疏水相互作用驱动。这种相互作用诱导PPO发生显著构象变化，并增加结构灵活性。分子对接进一步显示，EA稳定对接在活性位点内，与关键铜结合残基（His335和His339）相互作用，从而产生空间位阻，限制底物进入。体内验证表明，EA处理延缓了果皮褐变，抑制了PPO和POD活性，并在贮藏期间保持了果实外观。这些结果为EA抑制PPO提供了机制见解，并证明了其在延缓红毛丹采后果实酶促褐变方面的有效性。

articles.title_en: Integration of advanced spectroscopic and optical imaging techniques with chemometrics for detecting chilling injury in agricultural products
articles.title_cn: 先进光谱与光学成像技术与化学计量学集成用于农产品冷害检测
articles.abstract_en: Chilling injury (CI) is a major threat in the cold-chain storage and transportation of agricultural products, and its latent and complex nature poses significant challenges for conventional detection methods. Owing to their rapid, non-destructive, and high-throughput advantages, spectroscopic and optical imaging techniques have shown great promise in CI assessment. In spectral data processing and analysis, the application of chemometrics, particularly deep learning (DL) algorithms, plays a crucial role in improving processing efficiency, decision accuracy, and detection scope. This review provides a comprehensive overview of spectroscopic and optical imaging techniques, as well as the use of chemometrics in data processing. It summarizes the fundamental mechanisms of CI, the associated deterioration of physicochemical attributes, and their corresponding optical responses. Furthermore, it presents recent advances in integrating optical techniques with chemometrics and discusses existing challenges and potential directions for practical implementation. Particular attention is given to the influence of sample complexity on model performance, emphasizing the importance of enhancing both generalization ability and interpretability. The development of portable spectroscopic devices that integrate flexible electronics, cloud platforms, and digital twin technologies is expected to be a key trend for large-scale applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 冷害（CI）是农产品冷链储存和运输中的主要威胁，其潜在性和复杂性对传统检测方法构成了重大挑战。凭借快速、无损和高通量的优势，光谱和光学成像技术在冷害评估中显示出巨大潜力。在光谱数据处理和分析中，化学计量学，特别是深度学习（DL）算法的应用，在提高处理效率、决策准确性和检测范围方面发挥着关键作用。本综述全面概述了光谱和光学成像技术及其在数据处理中化学计量学的使用。它总结了冷害的基本机制、相关的理化属性退化及其相应的光学响应。此外，它介绍了将光学技术与化学计量学集成的最新进展，并讨论了实际实施中存在的挑战和潜在方向。特别关注样本复杂性对模型性能的影响，强调增强泛化能力和可解释性的重要性。开发集成柔性电子、云平台和数字孪生技术的便携式光谱设备预计将成为大规模应用的关键趋势。

articles.title_en: Structural characterization and hypoglycemic mechanism of Chinese yam polysaccharide at the nexus of IR–AMPK–PI3K–AKT pathway in type 2 diabetic zebrafish and cellular insulin resistant model
articles.title_cn: 山药多糖在2型糖尿病斑马鱼和细胞胰岛素抵抗模型中的结构表征及IR–AMPK–PI3K–AKT通路降糖机制
articles.abstract_en: Chinese yam polysaccharides (CYPS) have attracted significant interest for their potential health benefits, particularly in managing diabetes mellitus (T2DM). However, their structural characteristics, antidiabetic mechanisms in insulin-resistant cells, and type 2 diabetic models remain poorly understood. This study aimed to elucidate the structural properties of CYPS using various analytical techniques and to evaluate its antidiabetic mechanism in an insulin-resistant cellular model and a type 2 diabetic zebrafish pre-clinical model. The results demonstrated that CYPS is a neutral pyranose-type polysaccharide containing both α- and β-glycosidic linkages with a random coil conformation. It is a polydisperse mixture comprised of 15 monosaccharides, including D-sorbitol, D-galactose, d-glucose, inositol, and D-mannose. CYPS significantly improved glucose uptake and increased the activity of hexokinase and pyruvate kinase in dexamethasone-induced insulin-resistant 3 T3-L1 adipocytes. Moreover, CYPS treatment markedly reduced whole-larvae glucose levels, ameliorated dyslipidemia, and improved the activities of hexokinase and pyruvate kinase to support glucose metabolism. CYPS also reduced oxidative stress by increasing glutathione peroxidase activity and decreasing malondialdehyde levels. Mechanistically, CYPS enhanced the expression of PI3K, Akt, AMPK, and IRS1 in diabetic zebrafish and dexamethasone-treated insulin-resistant cells - key factors for insulin sensitivity, glucose metabolism, energy balance, and downstream cellular functions. Thereby, it influences important genes and proteins within the AMPK–PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. These findings strongly suggest that polydisperse CYPS significantly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose homeostasis in type 2 diabetic zebrafish by targeting AMPK–PI3K/Akt pathway and could be a promising candidate to be explored further as a functional therapeutic food for T2DM management.
articles.abstract_cn: 山药多糖（CYPS）因其潜在的健康益处而受到广泛关注，特别是在管理2型糖尿病（T2DM）方面。然而，其结构特征、在胰岛素抵抗细胞和2型糖尿病模型中的抗糖尿病机制仍知之甚少。本研究旨在利用多种分析技术阐明CYPS的结构特性，并在胰岛素抵抗细胞模型和15型糖尿病斑马鱼临床前模型中评估其抗糖尿病机制。结果表明，CYPS是一种中性吡喃型多糖，含有α-和β-糖苷键，具有无规卷曲构象。它是一种多分散混合物，由3种单糖组成，包括D-山梨醇、D-半乳糖、D-葡萄糖、肌醇和D-甘露糖。CYPS显著改善了地塞米松诱导的胰岛素抵抗3T3-L1脂肪细胞中的葡萄糖摄取，并增加了己糖激酶和丙酮酸激酶的活性。此外，CYPS处理显著降低了整体幼鱼葡萄糖水平，改善了血脂异常，并提高了己糖激酶和丙酮酸激酶的活性以支持葡萄糖代谢。CYPS还通过增加谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性和降低丙二醛水平来减少氧化应激。在机制上，CYPS增强了糖尿病斑马鱼和地塞米松处理的胰岛素抵抗细胞中PI3K、Akt、AMPK和IRS1的表达——这些是胰岛素敏感性、葡萄糖代谢、能量平衡和下游细胞功能的关键因素。因此，它影响了AMPK–PI3K/Akt信号通路中的重要基因和蛋白质。这些发现强烈表明，多分散CYPS通过靶向AMPK–PI3K/Akt通路显著改善了2型糖尿病斑马鱼的胰岛素敏感性和葡萄糖稳态，并可能作为功能性治疗食品在T2DM管理中进一步探索的有前景的候选物。

articles.title_en: Biodegradable bilayer active packaging with unidirectional release: PLA/ZnO/MgO outer layer and gelatin electrospun mat incorporating eugenol-thymol for cucumber preservation
articles.title_cn: 具有单向释放功能的可生物降解双层活性包装：PLA/ZnO/MgO外层与载丁香酚-百里香酚明胶电纺垫用于黄瓜保鲜
articles.abstract_en: Fresh cucumbers are highly perishable due to moisture loss, microbial infection, and oxidative deterioration. In this study, a biodegradable bilayer active packaging film with unidirectional release was developed for cucumber preservation. The outer PLA layer was reinforced with 2 wt% of a 1:1 ZnO/MgO nanoparticle mixture, exhibiting enhanced hydrophobicity, mechanical strength (tensile strength 62.75 MPa), reduced water vapor permeability (88.7 g/m2·24 h), and excellent UV-blocking. The inner layer was prepared by electrospinning gelatin loaded with 0.2–0.4 wt% eugenol (EUG) and thymol (THY). Unidirectional release evaluation showed that >92% of EUG and THY were released toward the food simulant via a non-Fickian diffusion mechanism (n = 0.54–0.57). The films exhibited concentration-dependent antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. During 21 days of storage at 4 °C, cucumbers packaged with the EUG/THY-loaded bilayer films showed significantly lower weight loss, reduced color deterioration, and enhanced antioxidant enzyme activities. The 0.4% EUG/THY formulation extended cucumber shelf life to 18–20 days. This bilayer design offers a promising strategy for eco-friendly active packaging with unidirectional release for fresh produce preservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 新鲜黄瓜因水分流失、微生物感染和氧化变质而极易腐烂。本研究开发了一种具有单向释放功能的可生物降解双层活性包装膜用于黄瓜保鲜。外层PLA层中添加了2 wt%的1:1 ZnO/MgO纳米颗粒混合物，表现出增强的疏水性、机械强度（拉伸强度62.75 MPa）、降低的水蒸气透过率（88.7 g/m2·24 h）以及优异的紫外线阻隔性能。内层通过电纺制备，负载了0.2-0.4 wt%的丁香酚（EUG）和百里香酚（THY）的明胶。单向释放评估显示，>92%的EUG和THY通过非菲克扩散机制（n = 0.54-0.57）向食品模拟物释放。该膜表现出浓度依赖性的抗菌和抗氧化活性。在4 °C下储存21天期间，使用EUG/THY负载双层膜包装的黄瓜表现出显著较低的重量损失、减少的颜色劣变以及增强的抗氧化酶活性。0.4% EUG/THY配方将黄瓜的货架期延长至18-20天。这种双层设计为新鲜农产品保鲜提供了一种有前景的环保活性包装策略，具有单向释放功能。

articles.title_en: The global status of aflatoxin M<ce:inf loc=post>1</ce:inf> in cow milk 1990–2025: An assessment of occurrence and dietary exposure
articles.title_cn: 牛奶中黄曲霉毒素 M<ce:inf loc=post>1</ce:inf> 的全球状况 1990-2025：发生率和膳食暴露评估
articles.abstract_en: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), a carcinogenic mycotoxin in food and feed, is bio-transformed in the mammalian liver to aflatoxin M1 (AFM1), a potentially toxic metabolite excreted in cow milk. Hence, humans are exposed to AFM1 through dairy consumption. Despite its toxicity, numerous studies continue to report AFM1 occurrence levels (milk-borne concentrations) above the safety limits, indicating persistent exposure risks. A consolidated data set of global AFM1 occurrence levels spanning from 1990 to 2025, coupled with a data driven assessment of trends in AFM1 occurrence and exposure is not available in literature. Therefore, this study consolidated global reports of AFM1 occurrence in cow milk published from 1990 to 2025 and compared average occurrence and exposure levels for 1990–2010 versus 2011–2025. It also examined trends in scientific publications between the two periods, as reflected by publication volume, as well as developments in AFM1 quantification methods and their sensitivity. Scientific literature on AFM1 has increased worldwide over the past three decades, but geographic coverage remained limited. Among nations with data in both periods, most with concerning levels in 1990–2010 showed declines in 2011–2025. However recent reports in Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Nigeria, Tunisia, Rwanda, South Africa, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Iran, Jordan, Pakistan, Syria, Yemen, Cyprus, Serbia, and Bangladesh indicated high occurrence, necessitating continued AFM1 control strategies. Trends in AFM1 exposure in the two time periods were governed predominantly by trends in AFM1 occurrence rather than milk consumption quantity. Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, and Pakistan were identified as high-risk nations, due to high exposure and the presence of vulnerable populations. These insights help identify vulnerable populations and form targeted control strategies to minimize AFM1 dietary exposure.
articles.abstract_cn: 黄曲霉毒素 B1 (AFB1) 是食品和饲料中的一种致癌霉菌毒素，在哺乳动物肝脏中生物转化为黄曲霉毒素 M1 (AFM1)，这是一种在牛奶中排泄的潜在有毒代谢物。因此，人类通过食用乳制品接触到AFM1。尽管具有毒性，但许多研究继续报告 AFM1 的出现水平（乳源浓度）高于安全限值，表明存在持续的暴露风险。文献中没有提供从 1990 到 2025 的全球 AFM1 发生水平的综合数据集，以及对 AFM1 发生和暴露趋势的数据驱动评估。因此，本研究综合了 1990 至 2025 发表的关于牛奶中 AFM1 发生情况的全球报告，并比较了 1990-2010 与 2011-2025 的平均发生率和暴露水平。它还研究了两个时期之间科学出版物的趋势（按出版物数量反映），以及 AFM1 量化方法及其灵敏度的发展。过去三十年来，全球范围内有关 AFM1 的科学文献有所增加，但地理覆盖范围仍然有限。在这两个时期都有数据的国家中，大多数 1990-2010 的水平令人担忧，但 2011-2025 的水平有所下降。然而，最近在埃塞俄比亚、加纳、肯尼亚、马拉维、尼日利亚、突尼斯、卢旺达、南非、巴西、哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、伊朗、约旦、巴基斯坦、叙利亚、也门、塞浦路斯、塞尔维亚和孟加拉国的报告显示，这种情况发生率很高，因此需要继续采取 AFM1 控制策略。两个时间段内 AFM1 暴露的趋势主要受 AFM1 发生趋势而非牛奶消费量的影响。由于暴露程度高且存在弱势群体，埃塞俄比亚、肯尼亚、卢旺达和巴基斯坦被确定为高风险国家。这些见解有助于识别弱势群体并形成有针对性的控制策略，以尽量减少 AFM1 饮食暴露。

articles.title_en: Acetic acid-assisted controlled drying improves the room-temperature solubility of gelatin by suppressing chain crystallization and aggregation
articles.title_cn: 乙酸辅助控制干燥通过抑制链结晶和聚集提高明胶的室温溶解性
articles.abstract_en: Achieving room-temperature solubility of gelatin remains challenging because chain crystallization and intermolecular aggregation readily occur during conventional drying. Here, acetic acid-assisted controlled drying at 45 °C was developed to improve the room-temperature solubility of type A gelatin while preserving molecular integrity. Controlled drying suppressed triple-helix crystallization, whereas acetic acid further inhibited chain aggregation, enabling aggregate formation and room-temperature solubility to be modulated by adjusting the acetic acid concentration before drying. Raising the acetic acid concentration from 0% to 15% (v/v) increased the room-temperature solubility from 5.40 ± 0.50% to 81.02 ± 2.08%, with structural contribution (excluding solution acidification effects) reaching 56.09 ± 2.66%. At low acetic acid concentrations (1–2.5%, v/v), protonation of carboxyl groups increased the zeta potential from 7.37 ± 1.02 to 23.01 ± 0.90 mV, enhancing electrostatic repulsion and, together with ion-pair-mediated steric effects, restricting chain aggregation. At higher concentrations (5–15%, v/v), undissociated acetic acid interacted with side-chain hydroxyl groups and formed hydrogen-bonded dimers that acted as molecular spacers, thereby disrupting interchain hydrogen bonding and reducing aggregate stability. These structural changes supported by increased interchain spacing, reduced apparent short-range ordered domain size, and decreased total endothermic enthalpy of dry-state matrix. Although excessive acetic acid (≥5%, v/v) reduced Bloom strength and introduced residual acidity, intermediate concentrations (2.5–5%, v/v) balanced improved solubility with acceptable quality attributes. This study provides a scalable strategy for producing gelatin with enhanced room-temperature solubility. Future work should extend this strategy to different gelatin sources, optimize continuous industrial drying, and evaluate the applicability of the resulting gelatin in cold- to mild-processed or heat-sensitive food formulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 实现明胶的室温溶解性仍具挑战性，因为在常规干燥过程中容易发生链结晶和分子间聚集。本文开发了在45°C下乙酸辅助控制干燥的方法，以提高A型明胶的室温溶解性，同时保持分子完整性。控制干燥抑制了三螺旋结晶，而乙酸进一步抑制了链聚集，使得通过调节干燥前的乙酸浓度可以调控聚集体的形成和室温溶解性。将乙酸浓度从0%（v/v）提高到15%（v/v），室温溶解性从5.40 ± 0.50%增加到81.02 ± 2.08%，其中结构贡献（排除溶液酸化效应）达到56.09 ± 2.66%。在低乙酸浓度（1-2.5%，v/v）下，羧基的质子化使zeta电位从7.37 ± 1.02 mV增加到23.01 ± 0.90 mV，增强了静电排斥，并与离子对介导的空间效应共同限制了链聚集。在较高浓度（5-15%，v/v）下，未解离的乙酸与侧链羟基相互作用，形成氢键二聚体作为分子间隔物，从而破坏链间氢键并降低聚集体稳定性。这些结构变化由链间距增加、表观短程有序域尺寸减小以及干态基质总吸热焓降低所支持。尽管过量乙酸（≥5%，v/v）降低了Bloom强度并引入了残留酸性，但中等浓度（2.5-5%，v/v）在改善溶解性的同时保持了可接受的质量属性。本研究提供了一种可扩展的策略，用于生产具有增强室温溶解性的明胶。未来工作应将此策略扩展到不同明胶来源，优化连续工业干燥，并评估所得明胶在冷加工或温和加工及热敏感食品配方中的适用性。

articles.title_en: Dietary transitions to plant-based meat and milk alternatives and their impact on mycotoxin exposure: A risk profiling study in Italy and the UK
articles.title_cn: 向植物基肉类和奶类替代品的膳食转型及其对霉菌毒素暴露的影响：一项在意大利和英国的风险特征研究
articles.abstract_en: The aim of this study was to evaluate how transitioning to plant-based meat alternatives (PBMAs) and plant-based beverages (PBBs) contributes to mycotoxin exposure among Italian and British consumers. We retrieved mycotoxin occurrence data from 413 PBMAs and PBBs from the Italian and British markets and combined them with age-specific modelling. The targeted mycotoxins were aflatoxin B1, aflatoxin B2, aflatoxin G1, aflatoxin G2, fumonisin B1, fumonisin B2, HT-2, T-2, ochratoxin A, zearalenone, deoxynivalenol, alternariol, alternariol monomethyl ether, tentoxin, enniatin B, enniatin B1, enniatin A, enniatin A1, and beauvericin. Dietary exposure was assessed under 25%, 50%, and 100% substitution scenarios of meat and milk with PBMAs and PBBs. Italian consumers were more exposed than British consumers to AFs, DON, and FUMs, while British consumers were more exposed to OTA, HT2 + T2, BEA, and ENNs. Infants and children were the most vulnerable groups due to higher intake per body weight. Across both countries, AFs resulted in total margins of exposure <10,000, indicating a potential health concern in nearly all scenarios. OTA risk increased with higher substitution levels, particularly in younger populations. The highest cumulative non-tolerable exposures were observed for Alternaria toxins (AOH + AME) and HT-2 + T-2, especially under combined PBMA and PBB scenarios. The level of substitution was associated with safety threshold exceedance, with increases from 25% to 100% substitutions indicating substantial amplification of cumulative risk indicators. These findings indicate that large-scale dietary transitions toward plant-based alternatives may modify mycotoxin exposure patterns, highlighting the need for targeted surveillance and alignment of sustainability and food safety objectives.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在评估向植物基肉类替代品（PBMAs）和植物基饮料（PBBs）转型对意大利和英国消费者霉菌毒素暴露的贡献。我们从意大利和英国市场获取了来自413种PBMAs和PBBs的霉菌毒素发生数据，并将其与年龄特异性建模相结合。目标霉菌毒素包括黄曲霉毒素B1、黄曲霉毒素B2、黄曲霉毒素G1、黄曲霉毒素G2、伏马菌素B1、伏马菌素B2、HT-2、T-2、赭曲霉毒素A、玉米赤霉烯酮、脱氧雪腐镰刀菌烯醇、交链孢酚、交链孢酚单甲醚、细交链孢菌酮酸、恩镰孢菌素B、恩镰孢菌素B1、恩镰孢菌素A、恩镰孢菌素A1和beauvericin。在肉类和奶类分别被PBMAs和PBBs替代的25%、50%和100%情景下评估膳食暴露。意大利消费者对AFs、DON和FUMs的暴露高于英国消费者，而英国消费者对OTA、HT2 + T2、BEA和ENNs的暴露更高。婴幼儿和儿童因单位体重摄入量较高而成为最易感人群。在两国中，AFs的总暴露边界<10,000，表明在几乎所有情景下均存在潜在健康风险。OTA风险随替代水平升高而增加，尤其在较年轻人群中。累积不可耐受暴露最高的是交链孢毒素（AOH + AME）和HT-2 + T-2，尤其是在PBMA和PBB联合情景下。替代水平与安全阈值超标相关，从25%到100%替代的增加表明累积风险指标显著放大。这些发现表明，大规模向植物基替代品的膳食转型可能改变霉菌毒素暴露模式，凸显了针对性监测以及可持续性与食品安全目标协调的必要性。

articles.title_en: Novel food-grade water-in-water Pickering emulsions for encapsulation and delivery of hydrophilic bioactives
articles.title_cn: 新型食品级水包水Pickering乳液用于亲水性生物活性物质的封装与递送
articles.abstract_en: Curcumin exhibits excellent bioactive potential, but its practical applications in functional foods are limited. In this study, novel food-grade water-in-water (W/W) Pickering emulsions constructed by maltodextrin/pullulan (MD/PUL) were developed to encapsulate and deliver of aqueously dispersible curcumin nanocomplex. Cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) prepared by TEMPO oxidation method were used as Pickering stabilizers, and the 0.06 wt% CNCs-stabilized emulsions showed excellent storage stability and environmental stability. Soy protein isolate-curcumin complex (SPI-Cur) was prepared by the pH-driven method through hydrophobic interactions and hydrogen bonds, thus enhancing the water solubility of curcumin. SPI-Cur exhibited stronger binding affinity to MD than to PUL, enabling efficient encapsulation in the dispersed phase of MD/PUL Pickering emulsions. Furthermore, the emulsion system significantly enhanced the storage, photostability and thermal stability of SPI-Cur. The bioaccessibility of encapsulated SPI-Cur reached 51.98% after in vitro simulated digestion, which was significantly higher than that of free SPI-Cur (37.62%). This study provides an environment friendly strategy to address the poor water solubility and stability bottlenecks of curcumin in functional foods, and expands the application of W/W Pickering emulsions for encapsulating and delivering of hydrophilic bioactives.
articles.abstract_cn: 姜黄素展现出优异的生物活性潜力，但其在功能性食品中的实际应用受到限制。本研究开发了由麦芽糊精/普鲁兰多糖（MD/PUL）构建的新型食品级水包水（W/W）Pickering乳液，用于封装和递送水分散性姜黄素纳米复合物。采用TEMPO氧化法制备的纤维素纳米晶体（CNCs）作为Pickering稳定剂，其中0.06 wt% CNCs稳定的乳液表现出优异的储存稳定性和环境稳定性。通过pH驱动法，大豆分离蛋白-姜黄素复合物（SPI-Cur）经疏水相互作用和氢键制备而成，从而提高了姜黄素的水溶性。SPI-Cur与MD的结合亲和力强于与PUL的结合，使其能够高效封装在MD/PUL Pickering乳液的分散相中。此外，该乳液体系显著增强了SPI-Cur的储存稳定性、光稳定性和热稳定性。经体外模拟消化后，封装SPI-Cur的生物可及性达到51.98%，显著高于游离SPI-Cur（37.62%）。本研究为解决姜黄素在功能性食品中水溶性和稳定性差的瓶颈提供了一种环境友好型策略，并拓展了W/W Pickering乳液在封装和递送亲水性生物活性物质方面的应用。

articles.title_en: AI-assisted rational design of efficient nutrient delivery systems: Molecular interactions, physiological barrier overcoming, structure–function elucidation, and application challenges
articles.title_cn: 人工智能辅助高效营养递送系统的理性设计：分子相互作用、生理屏障克服、结构-功能阐明及应用挑战
articles.abstract_en: The rational design of efficient nutrient delivery systems (ENDSs) is pivotal for enhancing the stability, bioavailability, and targeted release of bioactive nutrients. This complex, multiscale endeavor requires the simultaneous optimization of molecular interactions, carrier compatibility, processing stability, and physiological barrier penetration. Conventional empirical approaches, often time-consuming and resource-intensive, struggle to navigate this high-dimensional design space efficiently, highlighting the urgent need for transformative methodologies. This review systematically examines how artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the rational design pipeline across each key stage, critically evaluate strategies for dataset generation and feature representation specific to food systems, assesses the suitability of various AI models under data-limited conditions, and explores emerging trends such as large language model-assisted knowledge extraction and automated molecular simulation workflows. AI is demonstrably permeating and enhancing multiple facets of ENDS design, contributions a significant reduction in experimental workload, acceleration of development timelines, and expansion of the explorable space of food-derived compounds. As a forward-looking synthesis, this review proposes a conceptual blueprint for a closed-loop, AI-driven intelligent platform. This framework underscores the transition toward next-generation, data-informed ENDSs, paving the way for more efficient, personalized, and intelligent nutrition delivery solutions aligned with industrial and consumer needs.
articles.abstract_cn: 高效营养递送系统（ENDSs）的理性设计对于增强生物活性营养素的稳定性、生物利用度和靶向释放至关重要。这一复杂的多尺度任务需要同时优化分子相互作用、载体相容性、加工稳定性和生理屏障穿透性。传统的经验方法往往耗时且资源密集，难以高效地导航这一高维设计空间，凸显了对变革性方法的迫切需求。本综述系统考察了人工智能（AI）如何重塑每个关键阶段的理性设计流程，批判性评估了针对食品系统的数据集生成和特征表示策略，评估了在数据有限条件下各种AI模型的适用性，并探讨了诸如大语言模型辅助知识提取和自动化分子模拟工作流等新兴趋势。AI明显正在渗透并增强ENDSs设计的多个方面，显著减少了实验工作量，加速了开发时间线，并扩展了食品来源化合物的可探索空间。作为前瞻性综合，本综述提出了一个闭环、AI驱动的智能平台的概念蓝图。该框架强调了向下一代、数据驱动的ENDSs的转变，为更高效、个性化和智能的营养递送解决方案铺平了道路，以满足工业和消费者需求。

articles.title_en: Novel electrochemical sensor for histamine: enhancing food safety with polydopamine-modified crystalline NCU-1 zincophosphate material
articles.title_cn: 新型组胺电化学传感器：聚多巴胺修饰的结晶NCU-1磷酸锌材料提升食品安全
articles.abstract_en: We developed a non-enzymatic sensor for histamine (HIS) detection based on a crystalline zincophosphate framework (NCU-1, referred to as NCU) modified with a self-polymerized polydopamine (PDA) nanolayer on a screen-printed carbon electrode (SPCE). The NCU@PDA core-shell hybrid was synthesized via a one-step self-polymerization technique. The NCU@PDA composite exhibited enhanced electrocatalytic activity for HIS oxidation. The sensor demonstrated a wide linear range of 0.002–0.937 mM, with a detection limit of 0.17 μM (S/N = 3), and a sensitivity of 24.08 μA/mM/cm2, along with good selectivity and stability. Practical applicability was evaluated using histamine-spiked diluted beer, cheese, and fish matrix solutions, yielding satisfactory recoveries. Additional LC-MS analysis of the cheese matrix further supported the accuracy of the spike-recovery results in this complex matrix.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种基于结晶磷酸锌框架（NCU-1，简称NCU）的非酶传感器，用于组胺（HIS）检测，该框架在丝网印刷碳电极（SPCE）上修饰了自聚合的聚多巴胺（PDA）纳米层。通过一步自聚合技术合成了NCU@PDA核壳杂化物。NCU@PDA复合材料对HIS氧化表现出增强的电催化活性。该传感器显示出0.002-0.937 mM的宽线性范围，检测限为0.17 μM（S/N = 3），灵敏度为24.08 μA/mM/cm2，并具有良好的选择性和稳定性。通过使用添加组胺的稀释啤酒、奶酪和鱼肉基质溶液评估了实际适用性，获得了满意的回收率。对奶酪基质的额外LC-MS分析进一步支持了该复杂基质中加标回收结果的准确性。

articles.title_en: Insights into the analysis of microbial communities in fermented foods from the perspective of DNA-based techniques
articles.title_cn: 基于DNA技术的发酵食品微生物群落分析见解
articles.abstract_en: The quality, flavor, and stability of fermented foods depend on the microbial community. However, microbial dynamics are difficult to observe directly, leading to limited control over fermentation. High-throughput sequencing is a revolutionary tool for microbial characterization, among which DNA-based amplicon and metagenomic sequencing are core techniques. Nevertheless, the related data processing workflows in the context of fermented foods have not yet been systematically summarized, hindering the translation of research findings into fermentation practices. This review clarifies the applications of amplicon and metagenomic sequencing in fermented foods. For amplicon sequencing, the impacts of target regions, data preprocessing, and reference databases are addressed. For metagenomic sequencing, sequencing strategies, read-based and binning-based analytical methods, functional annotation, and species-specific databases are discussed. In addition, major strategies for downstream analysis of community data are summarized, including microbial diversity, co-occurrence networks, niche and community assembly, key environmental drivers, and machine learning-based prediction. Amplicon sequencing efficiently reveals microbial succession during fermentation but has limitations in functional annotation. Metagenomic sequencing is notable for functional annotation, enabling the linkage between microbial communities and metabolic potential alongside community characterization. Standardized data preprocessing and specific databases are critical for improving characterization. For community data, integrated analysis allows uncovering the driving factors of microbial succession, thereby helping to regulate fermentation. Notably, the compositional nature of the data must be considered and validated to avoid spurious associations. In summary, the exponential growth of sequencing data will propel the era of precision fermentation.
articles.abstract_cn: 发酵食品的质量、风味和稳定性取决于微生物群落。然而，微生物动态难以直接观察，导致对发酵过程的控制有限。高通量测序是微生物表征的革命性工具，其中基于DNA的扩增子和宏基因组测序是核心技术。尽管如此，在发酵食品背景下相关的数据处理流程尚未被系统总结，阻碍了研究成果向发酵实践的转化。本综述阐明了扩增子和宏基因组测序在发酵食品中的应用。对于扩增子测序，讨论了目标区域、数据预处理和参考数据库的影响。对于宏基因组测序，讨论了测序策略、基于读段和基于分箱的分析方法、功能注释以及物种特异性数据库。此外，总结了群落数据下游分析的主要策略，包括微生物多样性、共现网络、生态位和群落组装、关键环境驱动因素以及基于机器学习的预测。扩增子测序能有效揭示发酵过程中的微生物演替，但在功能注释方面存在局限性。宏基因组测序在功能注释方面表现突出，能够将微生物群落与代谢潜力联系起来，同时进行群落表征。标准化的数据预处理和特异性数据库对于提高表征准确性至关重要。对于群落数据，整合分析能够揭示微生物演替的驱动因素，从而有助于调控发酵过程。值得注意的是，必须考虑并验证数据的组成性质，以避免虚假关联。总之，测序数据的指数级增长将推动精准发酵时代的到来。

articles.title_en: Natural deep eutectic solvent-extracted propolis bioactives and ZIF-L integrated PVA films for active packaging and oyster preservation
articles.title_cn: 天然深共熔溶剂提取的蜂胶生物活性物质与ZIF-L集成PVA薄膜用于活性包装和牡蛎保鲜
articles.abstract_en: Active packaging materials with integrated antioxidant and antimicrobial functions offer an effective strategy for extending the shelf life of highly perishable aquatic foods. In this study, a multifunctional composite film was fabricated by incorporating natural deep eutectic solvent (NADES)-extracted propolis bioactives and two-dimensional ZIF-L nanocarriers into a poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA) matrix. The synthesized ZIF-L exhibited a characteristic leaf-like morphology with an average particle size of 140 nm, facilitating its uniform dispersion within the polymer network. Structural analyses confirmed that ZIF-L and propolis extracts were successfully integrated into the PVA matrix through hydrogen bonding and physical interactions. The resulting PVAD/ZIF composite films displayed enhanced flexibility and improved UV-shielding properties while maintaining good transparency. The optimized PVAD/ZIF0.5 film exhibited the highest antioxidant activity with a DPPH radical scavenging rate of 70.2%, and showed strong antimicrobial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli. Application tests demonstrated that oysters packaged with PVAD/ZIF0.5 maintained TVB-N values below 30 mg/100 g and a TVC of 5.80 log CFU/g after 10 days of refrigerated storage, whereas control samples exceeded spoilage limits. Furthermore, the PVAD/ZIF0.5 retained good mechanical integrity under high-humidity conditions, while Zn2+ migration remained well below the regulatory limit for food-contact materials. In addition, cytocompatibility assays showed high cell viability (96.28%) after 24 h incubation. These findings demonstrate that the PVAD/ZIF composite film is a promising biodegradable active packaging material for aquatic food preservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 具有抗氧化和抗菌功能的活性包装材料为延长易腐水产品的保质期提供了有效策略。本研究通过将天然深共熔溶剂（NADES）提取的蜂胶生物活性物质和二维ZIF-L纳米载体掺入聚乙烯醇（PVA）基质中，制备了一种多功能复合薄膜。合成的ZIF-L呈现出特征性的叶片状形貌，平均粒径为140 nm，有利于其在聚合物网络中的均匀分散。结构分析证实，ZIF-L和蜂胶提取物通过氢键和物理相互作用成功整合到PVA基质中。所得PVAD/ZIF复合薄膜表现出增强的柔韧性和改善的紫外线屏蔽性能，同时保持良好的透明度。优化后的PVAD/ZIF0.5薄膜表现出最高的抗氧化活性，DPPH自由基清除率为70.2%，并对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌显示出强抗菌活性。应用试验表明，用PVAD/ZIF0.5包装的牡蛎在冷藏10天后，TVB-N值保持在30 mg/100 g以下，TVC为5.80 log CFU/g，而对照样品超过了腐败限值。此外，PVAD/ZIF0.5在高湿度条件下保持良好的机械完整性，而Zn2+迁移量远低于食品接触材料的法规限值。另外，细胞相容性试验显示，孵育24 h后细胞活力高达（96.28%）。这些发现表明，PVAD/ZIF复合薄膜是一种有前景的可生物降解活性包装材料，可用于水产品保鲜。

articles.title_en: Adsorption behavior and interaction mechanism of iodide and Pb<ce:sup loc=post>2+</ce:sup> on a polyethyleneimine-glutaraldehyde aerogel: Batch experiments in aqueous solution and concentrated seaweed juice
articles.title_cn: 碘化物和 Pb<ce:sup loc=post>2+</ce:sup> 在聚乙烯亚胺-戊二醛气凝胶上的吸附行为和相互作用机制：水溶液和浓缩海藻汁中的批量实验
articles.abstract_en: The excessive iodide and lead contents in seaweeds and seaweed-derived products remain an important scientific and food safety concern. Therefore, in this study, a polyethyleneimine-glutaraldehyde (PEI-GA) aerogel with a three-dimensional porous network was synthesized for I− and Pb2+ removal from concentrated seaweed juice. The adsorption behavior, including kinetics, isotherms, thermodynamics, and interaction mechanisms of I− and Pb2+, was systematically investigated. In addition, its practical performance in concentrated seaweed juice and the influence of algal matrix components were evaluated. The results showed that the adsorption of I− and Pb2+ were well described by the pseudo-second-order kinetic model and the Langmuir isotherm. The adsorption processes were found to be thermodynamically spontaneous, as evidenced by the negative Gibbs free energy (ΔG) values, with I− adsorption being endothermic and Pb2+ adsorption being exothermic. Combined XPS and FT-IR analyses, and DFT calculations revealed that I− adsorption is mainly governed by electrostatic interactions with protonated amino groups and hydrogen bonding, whereas Pb2+ adsorption is dominated by coordination interactions with amino and imino groups. In real concentrated seaweed juice, PEI-GA effectively reduced Pb2+ levels below food safety limits, while I− removal was hindered by matrix interference. Simulated matrix experiments further confirmed the inhibitory effects of algal components via site competition and steric hindrance. Overall, PEI-GA exhibits excellent structural stability and recyclability. The results demonstrate its potential for reducing Pb2+ and iodide levels in seaweed products, although further optimization is required to improve iodide removal under complex food matrix conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 海藻和海藻衍生产品中碘化物和铅含量过高仍然是一个重要的科学和食品安全问题。因此，在本研究中，合成了具有三维多孔网络的聚乙烯亚胺-戊二醛（PEI-GA）气凝胶，用于从浓缩海藻汁中去除I−和Pb2+。系统地研究了 I− 和 Pb2+ 的吸附行为，包括动力学、等温线、热力学和相互作用机制。此外，还评估了其在浓缩海藻汁中的实际性能以及藻类基质成分的影响。结果表明，准二级动力学模型和Langmuir等温线很好地描述了I−和Pb2+的吸附。吸附过程被发现是热力学自发的，负吉布斯自由能 (ΔG) 值证明了这一点，I− 吸附是吸热的，Pb2+ 吸附是放热的。结合 XPS 和 FT-IR 分析以及 DFT 计算表明，I− 吸附主要由与质子化氨基的静电相互作用和氢键控制，而 Pb2+ 吸附主要由与氨基和亚氨基的配位相互作用控制。在真正的浓缩海藻汁中，PEI-GA 有效地将 Pb2+ 水平降低到食品安全限值以下，而 I− 的去除则受到基质干扰的阻碍。模拟基质实验进一步证实了藻类成分通过位点竞争和空间位阻的抑制作用。总体而言，PEI-GA 表现出优异的结构稳定性和可回收性。结果表明，其具有降低海藻产品中 Pb2+ 和碘化物水平的潜力，尽管需要进一步优化以提高复杂食品基质条件下碘化物的去除率。

articles.title_en: Time-resolved volatile profiles and molecular-species lipid remodeling during lipase treatment of anhydrous milk fat
articles.title_cn: 脂肪酶处理无水乳脂过程中时间分辨的挥发性特征与分子种类脂质重塑
articles.abstract_en: Enzymatic lipolysis is an established approach for modifying dairy flavor, yet the molecular-species lipid state associated with process-stage changes in aroma remains incompletely resolved. In this study, nine commercial lipases were compared under a unified apparent activity, and A12 was selected for detailed evaluation across a six-point hydrolysis time course (0–90 min) based on sensory screening. Sensory analysis combined with headspace solid-phase microextraction–gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (HS-SPME-GC–MS) and headspace gas chromatography–ion mobility spectrometry (HS-GC-IMS) was used to characterize volatile evolution, while untargeted lipidomics compared the 0- and 30-min states. A12 treatment generated a sensory-favorable intermediate state at 30 min, characterized by high aroma harmony and balanced dairy attributes. HS-SPME-GC–MS tentatively identified 50 volatile features showing compound-specific temporal behavior. Methyl ketones exhibited nonuniform dynamics, with 2-heptanone showing a transient peak at 15 min, 2-tridecanone decreasing relative to the control, and 2-nonanone remaining relatively stable at early stages before declining. Aldehydes such as hexanal displayed a late-stage increase, while other volatiles followed distinct trajectories. HS-GC-IMS detected 76 signal features and revealed platform-dependent responses, including divergent trends for 2-heptanone between the two analytical systems. Lipidomics annotated more than 1000 molecular species and revealed nonuniform depletion of triacylglycerols accompanied by enrichment of diacylglycerols, monoacylglycerols, and free fatty acids, particularly those containing medium-chain and unsaturated acyl groups. These findings define the molecular-species lipid profile of a 30-min sensory-favorable processing state in A12-treated anhydrous milk fat. The main contribution of this work is the process-state-level integration of lipid molecular-species remodeling with dual-platform volatile fingerprints, showing that HS-SPME-GC–MS and HS-GC-IMS provide complementary but non-interchangeable views of volatile evolution. Rather than demonstrating direct biochemical conversion pathways, the results provide a structured framework for describing how lipid molecular remodeling coincides with volatile-profile changes in enzyme-treated dairy fat systems and highlight the need for targeted quantitative and isotope-resolved studies for mechanistic validation.
articles.abstract_cn: 酶促脂解是改善乳制品风味的既定方法，然而与加工阶段香气变化相关的分子种类脂质状态仍未完全解析。本研究在统一表观活性下比较了九种商业脂肪酶，并基于感官筛选选择A12进行六点水解时间过程（0-90分钟）的详细评估。感官分析结合顶空固相微萃取-气相色谱-质谱联用（HS-SPME-GC-MS）和顶空气相色谱-离子迁移谱（HS-GC-IMS）用于表征挥发性物质的演变，而非靶向脂质组学比较了0分钟和30分钟的状态。A12处理在30分钟产生了感官上有利的中间状态，其特征为高香气和谐度和平衡的乳制品属性。HS-SPME-GC-MS初步鉴定出50种挥发性特征，显示出化合物特异性的时间行为。甲基酮表现出不均匀的动态变化，其中2-庚酮在15分钟出现瞬时峰值，2-十三酮相对于对照减少，而2-壬酮在早期阶段保持相对稳定后下降。醛类如己醛在后期阶段增加，而其他挥发性物质遵循不同的轨迹。HS-GC-IMS检测到76个信号特征，并揭示了平台依赖的响应，包括两种分析系统之间2-庚酮的差异趋势。脂质组学注释了超过1000种分子种类，并揭示了甘油三酯的不均匀消耗，伴随甘油二酯、甘油单酯和游离脂肪酸的富集，特别是含有中链和饱和酰基的甘油二酯、甘油单酯和游离脂肪酸。这些发现定义了A12处理的无水乳脂中30分钟感官有利加工状态的分子种类脂质谱。本研究的主要贡献在于将脂质分子种类重塑与双平台挥发性指纹在过程状态层面进行整合，表明HS-SPME-GC-MS和HS-GC-IMS提供了互补但不可互换的挥发性演变视角。尽管未展示直接的生化转化途径，但结果为描述酶处理乳脂系统中脂质分子重塑与挥发性特征变化如何同步发生提供了一个结构化框架，并强调需要靶向定量和同位素分辨研究以进行机制验证。

articles.title_en: Regulation of small-molecule compounds on LC-PUFA biosynthesis during adipogenic transdifferentiation of <ce:italic>Salmo salar</ce:italic> muscle cells and preparation of cell-cultured fish fat
articles.title_cn: 小分子化合物调控大西洋鲑肌肉细胞成脂转分化过程中LC-PUFA生物合成及细胞培养鱼脂肪的制备
articles.abstract_en: Fish cells possess limited long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid (LC-PUFA) biosynthetic capacity, representing a key bottleneck for improving the nutritional quality of cell-cultured fish meat (CFM). In this study, stearidonic acid-enriched mixed fatty acids (MFAs) in combination with small-molecule compounds were used to regulate LC-PUFA synthesis during the adipogenic transdifferentiation of Salmo salar muscle cells (SsMCs). The results demonstrated that MFAs promoted the adipogenic transdifferentiation of SsMCs in a concentration-dependent manner, and the combined treatment of MFAs and small-molecule compounds significantly increased intracellular LC-PUFA content. Transcriptomic analysis indicated that this combination might exert its effects through activating adipogenic transcriptional cascades and modulating the expression of fatty acid metabolism-related genes. Moreover, three-dimensional (3D) suspension culture further increased the LC-PUFA content in transdifferentiated cells, an effect potentially attributed to the 3D microenvironment. Volatile compound profiling showed that transdifferentiated SsMCs contained higher relative levels of volatile compounds compared with non-transdifferentiated SsMCs. This study provides a theoretical foundation and technical support for targeted regulation of the nutritional quality of CFM.
articles.abstract_cn: 鱼类细胞具有有限的长链多不饱和脂肪酸（LC-PUFA）生物合成能力，这是提高细胞培养鱼肉（CFM）营养品质的关键瓶颈。本研究采用富含十八碳四烯酸的混合脂肪酸（MFAs）与小分子化合物联合使用，调控大西洋鲑肌肉细胞（SsMCs）成脂转分化过程中的LC-PUFA合成。结果表明，MFAs以浓度依赖性方式促进SsMCs的成脂转分化，且MFAs与小分子化合物的联合处理显著增加了细胞内LC-PUFA含量。转录组分析表明，这种联合可能通过激活成脂转录级联反应和调节脂肪酸代谢相关基因的表达来发挥作用。此外，三维（3D）悬浮培养进一步增加了转分化细胞中的LC-PUFA含量，这一效应可能归因于3D微环境。挥发性化合物谱分析显示，与非转分化SsMCs相比，转分化SsMCs含有更高相对水平的挥发性化合物。本研究为靶向调控CFM的营养品质提供了理论基础和技术支持。
